method: Exact complete top-level declarations selected for RPC identity, cancellation, mutation receipts and worker lifecycle. Unselected declarations remain outside REA scope.

index.method: inert AST index; exact source ranges, no evaluation

verification: Independently matched every selected byte range to original source, and verified SHA-256 and size of source/evidence. Index is broader than selected REA scope; imports do not establish dynamic binding.
